service_catalog.purpose: Candidate-facing exam runtime and lockdown client telemetry.
Photo/ID capture ingestion, AI photo analysis, and candidate comparison workflow telemetry.
Environment camera token/login and candidate camera setup flow before or during readiness.
Session orchestration, lifecycle state transitions, and exam metadata persistence.
Proctor assignment and assignment lifecycle transitions.
Conference room lifecycle and Twilio room orchestration.
Candidate/proctor messaging and support communication data.
Kubernetes runtime health, pod lifecycle, and container-level events.

primary_signals: SessionLogType=7 candidate rows
Entries.Metadata contains 'Candidate disconnected'
candidate-app network/socket disconnect traces
Entries.Metadata contains 'Proctor disconnected'
Entries.Metadata contains 'Readiness agent disconnected'
SessionLogType in (13,14)
candidate-app security marker: Lockdown bypass detected
CONTENT_PROTECTION_BYPASSED in session-log or AppTraces
event_taxonomy.tone_guidance: This is a content-protection verification failure, not a confirmed security breach. The application detected that OS-level screen-capture protection could no longer be verified and exited by design. Most commonly caused by local system conditions (OS behaviour, drivers, security software, VDI/remote desktop tools). Does not confirm content was captured or candidate acted intentionally. The session end is protective and preventative, not punitive.

primary_signals: candidate-app state transition to ProcessingStatus.UploadFailed during photo flow
fraud-model endpoint failures on candidate-photo or photos-v2
AppTraces/AppExceptions containing candidate-photo upload failure signatures

kql_templates.default: AppRequests | where _ResourceId contains 'fraud-model' | where Name has 'candidate-photo' or Name has 'photos-v2' | where Success == false | project TimeGenerated, ResultCode, Message, AppRoleInstance, customDimensions.ConfirmationCode, customDimensions.ExamSessionId | order by TimeGenerated desc | limit 100
kql_templates.with_error_detail: AppExceptions | where _ResourceId contains 'fraud-model' | where ProblemId has 'photo' or Message has 'photo' or Message has 'upload' | project TimeGenerated, ProblemId, Message, SeverityLevel, customDimensions | order by TimeGenerated desc | limit 50
kql_templates.correlation_by_session: AppRequests | where _ResourceId contains 'fraud-model' | where Name has 'candidate-photo' | project operation_Id, session_Id, TimeGenerated, ResultCode | join (AppTraces | where _ResourceId contains 'candidate-app' | project operation_Id, Message, TimeGenerated) on operation_Id | order by TimeGenerated asc

primary_signals: candidate-app state transition to ProcessingStatus.UploadFailed during ID flow
fraud-model endpoint failures on candidate-id
AppTraces/AppExceptions containing candidate-id upload failure signatures

kql_templates.default: AppRequests | where _ResourceId contains 'fraud-model' | where Name has 'candidate-id' or Name has 'candidateId' | where Success == false | project TimeGenerated, ResultCode, Message, AppRoleInstance, customDimensions.ConfirmationCode, customDimensions.ExamSessionId | order by TimeGenerated desc | limit 100
kql_templates.with_error_detail: AppExceptions | where _ResourceId contains 'fraud-model' | where ProblemId has 'id' or Message has 'identification' or Message has 'candidateId' | project TimeGenerated, ProblemId, Message, SeverityLevel, customDimensions | order by TimeGenerated desc | limit 50
kql_templates.comparison_with_photo: AppRequests | where _ResourceId contains 'fraud-model' | where (Name has 'candidate-photo' or Name has 'candidate-id') and Success == false | summarize FailureCount=count() by Name, ResultCode | order by FailureCount desc

primary_signals: environment-camera errors no_access_to_camera or generic_camera_error
candidate-app logs indicating camera access checks exhausted/retry max
media getUserMedia failures or blank stream timeout markers

kql_templates.default: AppTraces | where _ResourceId contains 'environment-camera' | where Message has 'Camera access check' or Message has 'camera' | project TimeGenerated, Message, SeverityLevel, customDimensions | order by TimeGenerated desc | limit 100
kql_templates.permission_denied: AppTraces | where _ResourceId contains 'environment-camera' | where Message has 'no_access_to_camera' or Message has 'CAMERA_NOT_ALLOWED_ERROR' | project TimeGenerated, Message, customDimensions.errorName, customDimensions.PodName | order by TimeGenerated desc
kql_templates.retry_exhaustion: AppTraces | where _ResourceId contains 'environment-camera' | where Message has 'reached max attempts' | project TimeGenerated, Message, customDimensions.checkIndex | order by TimeGenerated desc
kql_templates.exceptions: AppExceptions | where _ResourceId contains 'environment-camera' | where ProblemId has 'camera' or Message has 'getUserMedia' | project TimeGenerated, ProblemId, Message, SeverityLevel | order by TimeGenerated desc | limit 50

primary_signals: AI alert/check-not-fulfilled events with errorCode payload mapped to candidate UI
photo/id verification flow emits photo-and-id-error-alert and non-empty errorCodes
signalr alert messages for photo_check/id_check/comparison_check

kql_templates.default: AppTraces | where _ResourceId contains 'fraud-model' | where Message has 'check-not-fulfilled' or customDimensions.alertType in ('photo_check', 'id_check', 'comparison_check') | project TimeGenerated, customDimensions.alertType, customDimensions.errorCode, Message | order by TimeGenerated desc | limit 100
kql_templates.by_error_code: AppTraces | where _ResourceId contains 'fraud-model' | where customDimensions.errorCode has 'GEN' or customDimensions.errorCode has 'THR' or customDimensions.errorCode has 'ENV' | project TimeGenerated, customDimensions.errorCode, customDimensions.alertMessage, customDimensions.ConfirmationCode | order by TimeGenerated desc
kql_templates.signalr_health: AppDependencies | where _ResourceId contains 'fraud-model' or Target has 'signalr' | where Type == 'Signal' | project TimeGenerated, DependencyType, Target, Success, Duration, customDimensions | order by TimeGenerated desc | limit 50
kql_templates.candidate_app_correlation: AppTraces | where _ResourceId contains 'candidate-app' | where Message has 'photo-and-id-error-alert' or Message has 'IssuesDetectedModal' or customDimensions.component == 'issues-detected-modal' | project TimeGenerated, Message, customDimensions | order by TimeGenerated asc | limit 100

troubleshooting_playbooks.detection: No transition to accepted state; repeated requeue observed
likely_causes: Agent (proctor) disconnect before accepting
Backend retry loop in assignment service
Twilio task state mismatch preventing acceptance
signals_to_check: AppTraces on assignments-api for repeated task accept failures or requeue events
AppDependencies failures on Twilio task creation or acceptance calls
getChatHistory for proctor-side communication gaps
Assignment/assignment for AssignmentStatus stuck in non-Active state
troubleshooting_playbooks.escalation_guidance: Escalate to AAT if assignment stays in requeue loop beyond expected SLA or if proctor disconnected permanently.

troubleshooting_playbooks.detection: Candidate or proctor reports no audio / one-way audio during session
likely_causes: Media initialization failure in candidate app
Dependency failure on conference/media service
Browser media permissions not granted
signals_to_check: AppTraces on candidate-app for media init or audio error messages
AppDependencies for conference/Twilio media call failures
getChatHistory for proctor/candidate messages reporting audio issues
PPR.Conferences/conference for room state and participant join/leave events
troubleshooting_playbooks.escalation_guidance: Escalate to platform team if dependency failures are systemic across multiple sessions in same window.

troubleshooting_playbooks.detection: Messages not delivered or delayed between candidate and proctor
likely_causes: Messaging pipeline failure or delay
Chat service dependency failure
EventHub/ServiceBus delivery lag
signals_to_check: getChatHistory to verify messages exist and timestamps for delivery gaps
AppDependencies on chat-api for downstream failures
AppTraces on chat-api for message delivery errors
Check KB PRT0810 (ServiceBus Queues) for queue health patterns
troubleshooting_playbooks.escalation_guidance: Escalate if chat service shows systemic delivery failures or ServiceBus queue depth abnormalities.

troubleshooting_playbooks.detection: Candidate reports blank/frozen screen at app launch or during session
likely_causes: App load or initialization failure in candidate app
JavaScript/frontend render error
Backend session load failure blocking app startup
signals_to_check: AppTraces on candidate-app for initialization or load errors around session start time
AppExceptions on candidate-app for unhandled render exceptions
Session timeline for login marker presence vs expected startup flow
getSessionData for session metadata to confirm session was actually created
troubleshooting_playbooks.escalation_guidance: Escalate to candidate-app team if blank screen occurs at login consistently or correlates with a deploy.

troubleshooting_playbooks.detection: Conference room has role0 (candidate) assigned to more than one role1/role2 (proctor)
likely_causes: Assignment service retry created second assignment without closing first
Stale Twilio task accepted by second agent after first accepted
signals_to_check: Query PPR.Conferences/conference for Room SID and participant metadata: validate role0 appears once and role1/role2 count
Assignment/assignment for multiple Active or Assigned records against same ExamSessionId
AppTraces on assignments-api for duplicate task creation events
troubleshooting_playbooks.output: Extract Room SID and confirm role count. If role0 -> >1 role1/role2 confirmed, collect Room SID + ConfirmationCode + Timestamp and escalate to AAT.
troubleshooting_playbooks.escalation_guidance: ALWAYS escalate duplicate sessions to AAT with Room SID, ConfirmationCode, participant metadata, and log evidence.

troubleshooting_playbooks.detection: Same candidate session appears as multiple Twilio tasks in requeue cycle
likely_causes: Assignment loop due to task not being cancelled before new task creation
Backend retry creating duplicate tasks on failure
signals_to_check: AppTraces on assignments-api for repeated task create or requeue patterns on same ExamSessionId
AppDependencies for Twilio task API repeated calls in short window
Assignment/assignment for multiple records with same ExamSessionId in non-terminal state
Check KB PRT0849 (Removing Task/Session) and PRT0933 (Ghost Tasks) for remediation steps
troubleshooting_playbooks.escalation_guidance: Escalate to AAT for ghost task cleanup. Reference KB PRT0933 for ghost tasks and PRT0849 for task/session removal.

troubleshooting_playbooks.detection: Backend reports 'Failed to kill process' for one or more applications in session
likely_causes: Orphaned process that did not respond to kill signal
Backend failure executing process termination
Lockdown service lost connection before kill completed
signals_to_check: AppTraces on candidate-app: search for 'Failed to kill process' or 'failed to kill app' to identify which process name failed
Session-log Entries.Metadata for kill-related events around same timestamp
getSessionTimeline for process signal context before/after failure
troubleshooting_playbooks.escalation_guidance: Escalate to AAT if kill failure resulted in session not completing cleanly. Reference KB PRT0849 for session removal steps.

troubleshooting_playbooks.detection: Candidate cannot submit photo/ID and UI shows upload failure or retry loop
likely_causes: fraud-model candidate-photo/candidate-id endpoint failure
exam-sessions photos-v2 upload failure
camera stream/permission instability causing invalid capture payload
token/subscription/auth header mismatch for upload call
signals_to_check: AppRequests failures for /fraud-model/{id}/candidate-photo, /fraud-model/{id}/candidate-id, /exam-sessions/{id}/photos-v2
AppTraces/AppExceptions around same timestamp for UploadFailed/camera errors
Candidate UI status transitions: UploadFailed vs AnalyzeFailed and corresponding error codes
Check auth failures (401/403), not found (404 exam session), and 5xx service errors
troubleshooting_playbooks.escalation_guidance: Escalate to fraud-model-api or candidate-app team when repeated upload failures occur across retries or across multiple sessions in same window.

troubleshooting_playbooks.detection: Candidate reports generic alert popup or issues-detected modal during photo/ID or check-in flow
likely_causes: signalr check-not-fulfilled event emitted with alert error code
photo/id analysis failure translated to UI modal
camera access or quality checks failing and surfacing user-facing alert
signals_to_check: Alert payload includes type photo_check/id_check/comparison_check with error codes
Photo/ID state contains AnalyzeFailed with populated errorCodes
Correlate alert timestamp with candidate-app/fraud-model traces to identify upstream cause
troubleshooting_playbooks.escalation_guidance: If popup is reproducible and backed by repeated alert codes for same stage, escalate with errorCode list + session timeline evidence.

known_false_positives.guidance: Treat as potentially benign unless correlated with assignment failure for the same session.

known_false_positives.signal: Single pod warning without downstream candidate impact
known_false_positives.guidance: Do not claim root cause from infra-only evidence; require session impact correlation.
Interpret in deny-list/security context; avoid classifying as exam failure by default.
Treat as informational by default; only escalate if terminate behavior or session disruption appears.

standard_troubleshooting_process.name: Identify issue
standard_troubleshooting_process.objective: Classify the reported symptom against the known issue taxonomy before pulling any data.
required_checks: Match the user-reported symptom to a core issue type (agent accept, audio, chat, blank screen, duplicate session, duplicate task, kill failure)
Lock investigation to explicit ConfirmationCode or ExamSessionId before running broad queries

standard_troubleshooting_process.name: Pull logs
standard_troubleshooting_process.objective: Gather all relevant data sources in parallel: Chat, App logs, Traces, Dependencies, Conference DB.
required_checks: Run getSessionData (App Insights + session-log + infra), getChatHistory, getSessionTimeline
Query PPR.Conferences/conference for Room SID and participant metadata when session or duplicate issues are suspected
Query Assignment/assignment for assignment state
Query AppTraces and AppDependencies for the relevant service

standard_troubleshooting_process.name: Reconstruct timeline
standard_troubleshooting_process.objective: Build a chronological sequence of events from all gathered data.
required_checks: Merge events from App Insights, session-log, chat, conference DB in timestamp order
Identify gaps or anomalies in expected session flow

standard_troubleshooting_process.name: Detect anomaly
standard_troubleshooting_process.objective: Identify the specific signal that deviates from normal session behavior.
required_checks: Cross-reference reconstructed timeline against expected lifecycle markers
Flag unexpected events: requeue, duplicate role, failed kill, missing login marker, media init failure

standard_troubleshooting_process.name: Confirm root cause
standard_troubleshooting_process.objective: Validate the anomaly against the deterministic issue workflow for the classified issue type.
required_checks: Use the deterministic workflow for the identified issue type
Do not claim root cause without matching deterministic signal evidence
For duplicate sessions: confirm role count from Conference DB before escalating

standard_troubleshooting_process.name: Prepare evidence
standard_troubleshooting_process.objective: Package the evidence needed for resolution or escalation.
required_checks: Collect Room SID, ConfirmationCode, Timestamp for AAT escalations
Attach participant metadata, relevant log/trace excerpts
Write a concise summary suitable for the support ticket

standard_troubleshooting_process.name: Escalate if needed
standard_troubleshooting_process.objective: Submit to AAT or platform team with complete evidence when issue matches escalation triggers.
required_checks: AAT triggers: duplicate sessions, kill failures, assignment inconsistencies
Include Room SID + ConfirmationCode + Timestamp + participant metadata + logs
Reference applicable KB article (PRT0920, PRT0842, PRT0849, PRT0810, PRT0933)
Candidate login markers: set confirmation code / confirmation code set
Identity/auth failure traces in AppTraces/AppExceptions
Session continuity after login marker in timeline
deterministic_issue_workflows.guardrail: Do not classify as relogin failure unless login marker is followed by explicit auth/session failure evidence.

required_checks: AssignmentStatus progression in Assignment/assignment
Conference room status consistency
Events broker traces for assignment delivery lag
deterministic_issue_workflows.guardrail: Do not blame assignment service without mismatch between assignment state and candidate session flow.

required_checks: SessionLogType 13/14 and candidate-app security markers
Confirm whether session ended (protective exit) vs alert-only with session continuing
Check candidate chat and session timeline for any corroborating evidence of intentional action
Note local system context: OS, drivers, security software, VDI/remote desktop tools can trigger this without candidate fault
deterministic_issue_workflows.consult: Escalate to AAT for review; AAT decides further routing. Do not independently classify as intentional breach without corroborating evidence.
deterministic_issue_workflows.guardrail: CONTENT_PROTECTION_BYPASSED is a verification failure, not a confirmed breach. Do not use alarming language (breach, stolen, malicious, intentional) without independent corroborating evidence. The application's session-end response is protective and preventative, not punitive. Most commonly caused by local system conditions.

required_checks: AppRequests result codes 408/429/5xx
AppDependencies timeout/failure correlation
Infrastructure pressure in same time window
deterministic_issue_workflows.guardrail: Do not attribute candidate impact from backend timeout unless session-level evidence aligns temporally.

required_checks: AppTraces on assignments-api for task accept failures, cancellations, or requeue events against the ExamSessionId
AppDependencies for Twilio task API failures during acceptance window
Assignment/assignment for AssignmentStatus stuck in Pending/Queued
getChatHistory for proctor messages about inability to accept
deterministic_issue_workflows.guardrail: Do not confirm agent accept failure without AppTraces or assignment state evidence showing non-acceptance.

required_checks: AppTraces on candidate-app for media initialization errors or audio device failures
AppDependencies for conference/Twilio media API call failures
PPR.Conferences/conference for participant join events and media state
getChatHistory for reports from proctor or candidate about audio
deterministic_issue_workflows.guardrail: Do not attribute audio failure to platform without ruling out candidate device/browser configuration.

required_checks: getChatHistory to verify whether messages exist and check delivery timestamps
AppDependencies on chat-api for downstream call failures
AppTraces on chat-api for message delivery errors
ServiceBus queue health for message delivery lag (KB PRT0810)
deterministic_issue_workflows.guardrail: First check getChatHistory to determine if messages actually exist before claiming platform failure.

required_checks: AppTraces on candidate-app for initialization, render, or load errors near session start time
AppExceptions on candidate-app for unhandled frontend exceptions
Session timeline for expected login markers vs actual startup sequence
getSessionData to confirm session was created on backend
deterministic_issue_workflows.guardrail: Distinguish between session not created (backend issue) vs session created but app failed to render (frontend issue).

required_checks: Query PPR.Conferences/conference for Room SID and count participants by role: role0=candidate, role1/role2=proctor
If role0 appears with more than one active role1/role2, duplicate session is confirmed
Query Assignment/assignment for multiple Active records against same ExamSessionId
AppTraces on assignments-api for duplicate task creation
deterministic_issue_workflows.output: Extract Room SID, ConfirmationCode, Timestamp, participant metadata.
deterministic_issue_workflows.guardrail: ALWAYS escalate to AAT when duplicate session is confirmed. Do not attempt to resolve without AAT involvement.

required_checks: AppTraces on assignments-api for repeated task create or requeue pattern on same ExamSessionId in short time window
AppDependencies for repeated Twilio task API calls
Assignment/assignment for multiple records in non-terminal state for same ExamSessionId
Reference KB PRT0933 (Ghost Tasks) and PRT0849 (Removing Task/Session)
deterministic_issue_workflows.guardrail: Escalate to AAT for task cleanup. Reference PRT0933 and PRT0849.

required_checks: AppTraces on candidate-app: search 'Failed to kill process' or 'failed to kill app' to identify which process failed
Session-log Entries.Metadata for kill-related markers around same timestamp
getSessionTimeline for process kill signal context before and after failure
Confirm whether session ultimately closed or remained orphaned
deterministic_issue_workflows.guardrail: Escalate to AAT if session did not close cleanly. Reference PRT0849 for session removal.

required_checks: AppRequests status and failure codes for /fraud-model/{id}/candidate-photo, /fraud-model/{id}/candidate-id, and /exam-sessions/{id}/photos-v2
Candidate-side status transitions (UploadFailed vs AnalyzeFailed) and related error codes
Fraud-model and candidate-app AppTraces/AppExceptions around capture timestamp
Auth/header issues (401/403), exam-session not found (404), or upstream 5xx
deterministic_issue_workflows.guardrail: Differentiate upload transport failure (UploadFailed) from analysis rejection (AnalyzeFailed). Do not conflate these failure modes.

required_checks: Candidate-app/environment-camera traces for camera permission denials and stream timeout retries
Correlate camera failures with subsequent photo/id upload failures in same session
Confirm whether alert popup/error modal was shown to candidate and which error code was surfaced
deterministic_issue_workflows.guardrail: If camera failed before upload request was attempted, classify as camera-access issue, not upload API failure.

aat_escalation_sop.description: Standard procedure for escalating issues to the AAT (Advanced Agent Team) that require direct intervention.
escalation_triggers: Duplicate session confirmed (role0 with multiple active role1/role2 in Conference DB)
Kill session failure resulting in unclosed session
Assignment inconsistency not resolvable by standard troubleshooting
Ghost task requiring direct queue cleanup
Proctor permanently disconnected with candidate stuck waiting

escalation_steps.detail: Confirm the trigger condition is met using deterministic data (Conference DB role count, AppTraces kill failure, Assignment state mismatch)
Gather: Room SID (from PPR.Conferences), ConfirmationCode, Timestamp of incident
Include participant metadata from Conference DB, relevant log/trace excerpts, and assignment state snapshot
Write a clear description: issue type, what was confirmed, what data was collected, and why escalation is needed
Create AAT ticket with all collected evidence. Reference applicable KB article.
Track ticket resolution. Notify stakeholder when resolved. Document outcome for future reference.
